sample_unit: patients with LVO stroke (84 pre-AI, 48 post-AI)

links.outcome: Treatment times and clinical outcomes before vs after AI LVO triage implementation
links.effect: Post-AI reduced door-to-EVT time by 30.2 min (95% CI -56 to -4.3), CT-to-EVT by 29.4 min; door-to-tPA not significant; mRS 0-1 26% vs 40%, not significant.
links.quote: The implementation of Heuron ELVO significantly reduced the door-to-EVT time (30.2 min, 95% CI, -56. to -4.3), CT-to-neurologist examination time (16.4 min, 95% CI, -27.6 to -5.3), and CT-to-EVT time (29.4 min, 95% CI, -53.6 to -5.0).

screen.reason: Evaluates the real-world clinical implementation (before-and-after) of an AI triage and notification tool for large vessel occlusion stroke on patient treatment times and outcomes.

primary.practice: automated triage and alert notification workflow
